note: The complete list of approved editions epicenter.so is allowed to republish. Nothing outside this list can reach the site: scripts/project-editions.ts reads exactly these edition folders and refuses every other path. Adding an entry is a deliberate editorial act, and the generated Markdown under src/content/writing/ is what the build actually reads.

editions.why: The founding statement of the principle Epicenter is built around: you should always be able to take your data with you.
How Epicenter chooses the words in its own model. Naming is the first design decision, not the last.
The standard every Epicenter interface is measured against: preserve the intention, hide the machinery.
Why this site offers a recording beside the prose. The ear catches what the eye repairs.
The case for spending years on something the market would call inefficient, which is also the case for building this in the open.
